Access Palm Beach Golf Experience

October 13 to 15, 2026
Palm Beach Gardens, Florida

Three days of private-club golf in Palm Beach Gardens, with the first round at Panther National.

This experience is sold only as a complete package. Every package includes three nights at a resort in Palm Beach Gardens, daily breakfast, a welcome dinner, and all three rounds with carts.

There is no golf-only, single-round or commuter option for this event. Golfers must book the full package with the resort stay.

Packages are limited. Contact us for package pricing and availability.
